text: panel left working folder. Click folder open , use drive buttons Places jump elsewhere, click part path. Make empty folder tutorial File > New folder… open . choose Basic Series > Example data, pick IODP 926 grey scale (Zeeden et al. 2013) press Run. file grey.txt appears folder. Click plot ; drag plot zoom double-click go back. data work way: text, csv (also semicolons decimal commas), Excel LAS files, depth time first column. tables columns, choose column file list.

title: Getting started: a complete analysis in CycloDesk
text: Choose Time Series > Spectral analysis. defaults compute multitaper spectrum (MTM) AR(1) red-noise background confidence levels. Press Run. peaks 95 % level listed figure. strongest 0.52 m 0.39 m: precession band. WaverideR documents 0.4 0.55 m band record ~22 kyr precession cycle, means sedimentation rate roughly 2 cm/kyr. spectrum written grey-mtm2.txt.

title: Getting started: a complete analysis in CycloDesk
text: Choose Time Series > Wavelet / superlet / synchrosqueezing press Run. scalogram shows period cycle changes depth, single spectrum . Try colour palettes, colour scale, Whiten give weak strong cycles contrast. result saved grey-wavelet.cyclodesk.rds; double-click later re-plot without recomputing.

title: Getting started: a complete analysis in CycloDesk
text: Choose Time Series > Track cycle hand scalogram. Section 1 already selects scalogram just computed; press Show scalogram. section 2, click points along bright band 0.5 m, top bottom record. snapped nearest power peak every click jumps band. Click point select , drag move , press Delete Backspace remove selected points. complete curve: Snap whole curve nearest peaks follows band every depth, guided points; Follow ridge (HMM) follows hidden Markov model; Smooth curve (LOWESS) removes jumps neighbouring peaks. section 3 (Helper lines) type 41, 100: periods obliquity short eccentricity track drawn scalogram. track right, lines follow bands .

what: 6. Floating age model and the extracted cycle
title: Getting started: a complete analysis in CycloDesk
text: section 4, set Duration tracked cycle 21 Cycle extract 100. : Extract cycle writes 100-kyr cycle, scaled track, grey-extract100.txt shows scalogram; Age model + tuned series writes floating age model (grey-age21.txt), sedimentation rate (grey-sedrate21.txt) tuned record (grey-tuned21.txt), shows age model tuned record extracted cycle top. Show scalogram can hide panels .

title: Getting started: a complete analysis in CycloDesk
text: age model right, amplitude precession modulated eccentricity. section 5, set Modulated cycle 21 Modulating cycle 100, press Run check. CycloDesk extracts 21-kyr cycle track, takes Hilbert envelope, extracts 100-kyr cycle envelope, compares 100-kyr cycle extracted record , floating time scale. correlation r shown lower panel. strong negative r also good result: proxy responds inversely eccentricity. band factors set width extracted band. Update every change track , check reruns whenever move point, can improve track watch r.

title: Getting started: a complete analysis in CycloDesk
text: Press Anchor solution… section 4. Anchor tab opens extracted 100-kyr cycle record floating age model starting model. Choose La2004 eccentricity target set Age top record approximate age biostratigraphy magnetostratigraphy. Click peak record (top), matching peak target (middle). One tie point shifts floating model; two give piecewise-linear age model keeps floating sedimentation rates beyond outer ties. bottom panel shows tuned record target correlation. Age model + tuned series writes anchored age model, tuned record tie points. Anchoring needs independent age control: good correlation wrong eccentricity cycle looks just convincing right one.

title: CycloDesk: point-and-click cyclostratigraphy in R
text: point--click workbench cyclostratigraphy paleoclimate time series, built R. CycloDesk puts R packages WaverideR astrochron behind menus buttons. Open folder data, pick tool, press Run: spectra, wavelets, filters, cycle tracking, age models, tuning, TimeOpt COCO, without writing code. Every step writes result plain text file next data records equivalent R code, anything click can repeated script. runs web browser, computer: data never leaves machine. Status: alpha. CycloDesk works used real records, menus, defaults file names may still change. Please report anything breaks, looks wrong confusing. Feedback now shapes first stable release.

title: CycloDesk 0.1.0 (alpha)
text: First public release, testing feedback. Menus, defaults file names may still change. Working-folder workflow: file browser drives, places, filter, drag--drop (Ctrl = copy); text, csv (also semicolons decimal commas), Excel LAS files. Plot, Basic Series, Math Time Series menus 40 tools, calling WaverideR astrochron; every result written next input Acycle-style suffix, R code step collected R code tab. Spectral analysis (MTM, LOWSPEC, MESA, AMTM, SWA, …), evolutive spectra, wavelets (22 mother wavelets), superlets synchrosqueezing 17 colour palettes, coherence, cross wavelet bispectral analysis. Track tab: track cycle hand scalogram (snap peaks, free points, HMM ridge following, snapping whole curve nearest peaks, LOWESS smoothing), helper lines cycles, boundary lines, floating age model, extraction cycle, tuning check amplitude modulation. Anchor tab: tie floating record La2004/La2010/La2011, insolation metronome clicking matching peaks. Filtering, age models, tuning, TimeOpt/eTimeOpt, COCO/eCOCO, rho1, DYNOT, PDA spectral moments. Windows launcher (SETUP.bat) desktop shortcut; checks day new versions CycloDesk WaverideR GitHub.
